Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.
2. The petitioner seeks bail in connection with a case registered for the offence punishable u/s 341/323/354(A)/504/506/376/511/34 of the IPC.
3. As per the prosecution case, allegation against the petitioner is of sexually assaulting the informant's daughter.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is quite innocent and has not committed any offence as alleged in the FIR.
No such occurrence in the manner as alleged, has ever taken place.
He has been falsely implicated in this case due to ulterior motive.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the charge has been framed against the petitioner, which is mentioned in the supplementary affidavit.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.34888 of 2024(2) dt.12-07-2024
The petitioner has one criminal antecedent and has been languishing in custody since 28.02.2024.
5. Learned APP for the State opposed the prayer for bail.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the above named petitioner is directed to be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two Madan Kumar @ Chhote vs The State Of Bihar on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178305449/
1 sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Court below where the case is pending/Successor Court in connection with Nawada (Town) P.S. Case No.817/2023, subject to the following conditions:
(1) One of the bailors will be own close relative of the petitioner who will give on affidavit genealogy as to how he is relative to petitioner.
